name: Maha Sura Singhanat
contribution: A Siamese military leader and statesman who served as the first Front Palace of the Chakri Dynasty.

checks.lead: Prince Maha Sura Singhanat (Thai: สมเด็จพระบวรราชเจ้ามหาสุรสิงหนาท, RTGS: Somdet Phra Boworaratchao Maha Surasinghanat; 1 November 1744 – 3 November 1803), born Bunma (Thai: บุญมา), was a Siamese military leader and statesman who served as the first Front Palace of the Chakri Dynasty. As the younger brother of King Rama I, he was a foundational figure in the establishment of the Rattanakosin Kingdom and played a decisive role in securing Siam's independence from Burmese incursions during the late 18th century.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
